constraints: methodType accepts one of the documented "Design Object Access" theme constants: Path project method (1), Path database method (2), Path project form (4), Path trigger (8), Path table form (16), Path class (32), Path volatile method (128).
The command does not check whether the method actually exists; an error is generated only when an invalid table name is passed.

overloadMerges.note: methodType, ptrTable, objectName, and formObjectName are all filled in by the command (parameter table marks each with the '←' return arrow), so their direction should be 'out', not the syntax-position default of 'in'.

params.name: methodType
params.description: Object type selector parsed from path

params.name: ptrTable
params.description: Pointer to the table, filled in when path references a table-form method or a trigger; otherwise left unset.

params.name: objectName
params.description: Form name (for a table-form or project-form path) or database method name (for a database-method path).

params.name: formObjectName
params.description: Form object name, filled in when path references an object method.
If passed, path is considered to designate a host database method when called from a component (otherwise ignored).
